name: wasel
description: Scores Tunisian cash-on-delivery orders for refusal risk from customer chat (Darija, Arabizi, Arabic, French) and drafts the confirmation. Human-approved.

paragraphs: Wasel scores the refusal risk of cash-on-delivery (COD) orders that customers place in chat, and helps a seller resolve the risky ones before a courier is sent.

A refused cash-on-delivery parcel costs the seller a wasted trip; one vendor guide puts refusals at 15 to 25 % for Tunisian fashion orders (industry-reported, see how the problem is sourced). Customers order in Tunisian Darija (Arabic script or Arabizi), French or a mix, often with an address like "near the mosque". Wasel reads the conversation, scores the order from 0 to 100, explains the score with the customer's own words, and drafts the one question that would reduce the risk (confirm, complete the address, or pay first). When the customer answers, the order is rescored and the app shows…
Live demo: wasel.runs-on.dev (free tier, may take about a minute to wake). Wasel is built by Z-Team. The source is open under the MIT licence, see LICENSE and TEAM.md for who works on it.
